core.text: Four first counts recorded eleven; three later mat supplements restored twelve without witnessed origins. These synthetic observations establish recorded shortages and supplementation, not borrower completion. Three late anomalies and rounded, partly unwatched timings cannot select a cause.

Retain incompatible explanations for a selected recovered shortage: H1 attributes its twelfth counter to delayed completion by that borrower; H2 attributes it to redistribution from another loan or volunteer handling. Seek witnessed provenance before choosing either. Count error remains a separate rival; independent disagreement alone does not identify the correct count.

Before issuing, separately verify candidate kit counts. Seventy-one accounted counters permit at most five complete kits plus eleven counters; issue only twelve-counter kits and account separately for residual counters. Distinguish five complete circulating kits from five simultaneously ready shelf kits; the availability target needs that clarification.

Prospectively select ordinary and direct-to-own-tray returns, observed sequentially. Hold intended demand and eligibility fixed, record deviations, and preserve full five-minute use. One volunteer watches transfer order; the other records an independent selected-tray count before counter movement. Log placement seconds, borrower arrivals, shortage reports, searches, transfers, mat counts, queues, active loans, and time remaining. Inspect at most one tray and keep the return area usable.

Repeat counts at placement and one, three, and five minutes where the block permits. Record transfers before supplementation; replenishment may restore inventory but proves no borrower origin. An unresolved shortage at five minutes fails reconciliation; an earlier block ending leaves follow-up incomplete. Use only twenty minutes and forty volunteer-minutes.

residue.text: Attended handback is a fallback intervention hypothesis that sacrifices self-service convenience. Measure waiting and staffing feasibility; altered attention and handling could explain any improvement. No success is stipulated.

Historical counter ownership, original count accuracy, unresolved location, and closing-time concentration remain unknown. Tray recurrence does not establish a tray defect. No new anomaly would leave both accounts unresolved; shared counting errors remain possible.

tension.account_a: H1: the recovered twelfth counter belongs to the selected borrower and arrives after their tray.
tension.account_b: H2: the recovered twelfth counter comes from another loan or volunteer redistribution; the shortage report may trigger its transfer.
tension.prediction_a: A watched borrower-origin arrival precedes any search or volunteer transfer and precedes independently agreed recovery; this supports H1 for that event only.
tension.prediction_b: Recovery follows a witnessed other-loan or volunteer transfer without borrower completion; this supports H2 for that event only. An unwatched counter or reduced shortages separates neither account.
